motions.info_slide_plain: "Citizen journalism refers to the practice where individuals, not professionally trained as journalists, engage in reporting news or sharing commentary. Utilizing social media, blogs, or other digital platforms, these citizens contribute to the dissemination of information, often capturing real-time events or local stories. Notable examples include the Arab Spring and Palestine, where social media posts fueled movements for political change, and the early documentation of the Black Lives Matter movement through smartphone videos."
motions.text: This house supports the rise of citizen journalism.
